description: This file contains the CSS styles for the student records management portal frontend. It includes variable definitions for light and dark themes, and styles for various components like the App, App-header, and theme toggle button.

classes.name: App
classes.description: Main container for the application, centralizes content display and applies primary styling.

classes.name: App-header
classes.description: Header section of the app that displays branding and navigation.

classes.name: theme-toggle
classes.description: Button for toggling between light and dark themes.
